title: Example: add contract validator CLI
objective: Illustrative TaskSpec machine block. Adds a command-line validator for V1 contract artifacts without changing application runtime code.

requirements.text: Reject artifacts whose artifact_type or schema_version is not supported.
Never print artifact contents in error output.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each committed example validates; each documented invalid case is rejected.

constraints.text: No network access and no dynamic import from artifact data.
